+title: Make the five non-Codable op results Encodable
+---
+## What
+`OperationDefinition.Output` must be `Encodable & Sendable`, because `OperationTool` JSON-encodes each result with `JSONEncoder` `.sortedKeys`. Five public results are only `Sendable, Equatable` today. Add `Encodable` conformance (not `Decodable`) so the tools can return them directly.
+
+- [ ] `Sources/FoundationModelsCodeContext/Ops/SearchCode.swift`: make `SearchCodeResult` (line 131), `SearchCodeMatch` (78) and `IndexingProgress` (51) `Encodable`. `SearchCodeMatch.hit` is `FoundationModelsRanker.Hit`, which is not `Codable` (Ranker `Hit.swift:52`). Write a custom `encode(to:)` for `SearchCodeMatch` that encodes the hit's score and signals as plain numbers. Do NOT ask the Ranker agent for a change.
+- [ ] `Sources/FoundationModelsCodeContext/Ops/FindDuplicates.swift`: `FindDuplicatesResult` (103), `DuplicateGroup` (69), `DuplicateMatch` (45), `DuplicateChunkRef` (6) become `Encodable`.
+- [ ] `Sources/FoundationModelsCodeContext/Ops/QueryAST.swift`: `QueryASTResult` (91), `ASTMatch` (71), `ASTCapture` (19) become `Encodable`.
+- [ ] `Sources/FoundationModelsCodeContext/Diagnostics/DiagnosticRecord.swift`: `DiagnosticsReport` (135), `DiagnosticRecord` (12), `Counts` (96) become `Encodable`. `Sources/FoundationModelsCodeContext/CodeContextState.swift`: `IndexProgress` (11) becomes `Encodable`. If a stored property is not encodable (for example a `Duration` or a URL), encode it as a documented plain value.
+- [ ] Write every comment in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `JSONEncoder().encode(_:)` compiles and succeeds for each of the five result types.
+- [ ] The JSON keys match the Swift property names (no renamed keys), except where a custom `encode(to:)` is documented.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/FoundationModelsCodeContextTests/ResultEncodingTests.swift`: one test for each result type. Build a value (with `insertChunk` / `withTemporaryWorkspace` from `TestSupport.swift`, or run the op against a temporary workspace with `FakeEmbedder`), encode it with `.sortedKeys`, and assert the expected keys and values in the JSON.
+- [ ] `swift build` exits 0.
+- [ ] `swift format lint -r --strict Sources Tests Examples IntegrationTests Package.swift` exits 0.
+- [ ] `swift test` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
